verses.original: בִּלְעָ֗ם וַיַּ֣רְא כִּ֣י ט֞וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹא־ הָלַ֥ךְ נְחָשִׁ֑ים כְּפַֽעַם־ בְּפַ֖עַם לִקְרַ֣את וַיָּ֥שֶׁת פָּנָֽיו׃ אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yar kî ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- hā·laḵ nə·ḥā·šîm kə·p̄a·‘am- bə·p̄a·‘am liq·raṯ way·yā·šeṯ pā·nāw ’el- ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: And when Balaam saw that it pleased . . . the LORD to bless - Israel he did not seek omens as on previous occasions . . . . . . but he turned his face toward the wilderness

verses.original: בִלְעָ֜ם אֶת־ וַיִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֹׁכֵ֖ן לִשְׁבָטָ֑יו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים׃ וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: ḇil·‘ām ’eṯ- way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl šō·ḵên liš·ḇā·ṭāw rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tə·hî ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: When Balaam - looked up . . . and saw - Israel encamped tribe by tribe the Spirit of God came upon him

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נְאֻ֤ם בִּלְעָם֙ בְּנ֣וֹ בְעֹ֔ר וּנְאֻ֥ם הַגֶּ֖בֶר הָעָֽיִן׃ שְׁתֻ֥ם
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar nə·’um bil·‘ām bə·nōw ḇə·‘ōr ū·nə·’um hag·ge·ḇer hā·‘ā·yin šə·ṯum
verses.literal: and he lifted up an oracle saying [This is] the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open

verses.original: נְאֻ֕ם שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵי־ אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶֽחֱזֶ֔ה מַחֲזֵ֤ה שַׁדַּי֙ נֹפֵ֖ל עֵינָֽיִם׃ וּגְל֥וּי
verses.transliteration: nə·’um šō·mê·a‘ ’im·rê- ’êl ’ă·šer ye·ḥĕ·zeh ma·ḥă·zêh šad·day nō·p̄êl ‘ê·nā·yim ū·ḡə·lui
verses.literal: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God who sees a vision from the Almighty who bows down with eyes wide open

verses.original: מַה־ טֹּ֥בוּ אֹהָלֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ṭō·ḇū ’ō·hā·le·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ miš·kə·nō·ṯe·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: How lovely are your tents O Jacob your dwellings O Israel

verses.original: נִטָּ֔יוּ כִּנְחָלִ֣ים כְּגַנֹּ֖ת עֲלֵ֣י נָהָ֑ר כַּאֲהָלִים֙ יְהוָ֔ה נָטַ֣ע כַּאֲרָזִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: niṭ·ṭā·yū kin·ḥā·lîm kə·ḡan·nōṯ ‘ă·lê nā·hār ka·’ă·hā·lîm Yah·weh nā·ṭa‘ ka·’ă·rā·zîm ‘ă·lê- mā·yim
verses.literal: They spread out like palm groves like gardens beside a stream like aloes the LORD has planted like cedars beside the waters

verses.original: מַ֙יִם֙ יִֽזַּל־ מִדָּ֣לְיָ֔ו וְזַרְע֖וֹ רַבִּ֑ים בְּמַ֣יִם מַלְכּ֔וֹ וְיָרֹ֤ם מֵֽאֲגַג֙ מַלְכֻתֽוֹ׃ וְתִנַּשֵּׂ֖א
verses.transliteration: ma·yim yiz·zal- mid·dā·lə·yāw wə·zar·‘ōw rab·bîm bə·ma·yim mal·kōw wə·yā·rōm mê·’ă·ḡaḡ mal·ḵu·ṯōw wə·ṯin·naś·śê
verses.literal: Water will flow from his buckets and his seed will have abundant water His king will be greater than Agag and his kingdom will be exalted

verses.original: אֵ֚ל מוֹצִיא֣וֹ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם ל֑וֹ יֹאכַ֞ל צָרָ֗יו גּוֹיִ֣ם יְגָרֵ֖ם וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶ֛ם יִמְחָֽץ׃ וְחִצָּ֥יו
verses.transliteration: ’êl mō·w·ṣî·’ōw mim·miṣ·ra·yim kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·p̄ōṯ rə·’êm lōw yō·ḵal ṣā·rāw gō·w·yim yə·ḡā·rêm wə·‘aṣ·mō·ṯê·hem yim·ḥāṣ wə·ḥiṣ·ṣāw
verses.literal: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox to devour hostile nations and crush their bones to pierce them with arrows

verses.original: כָּרַ֨ע שָׁכַ֧ב כַּאֲרִ֛י וּכְלָבִ֖יא מִ֣י יְקִימֶ֑נּוּ בָר֔וּךְ מְבָרֲכֶ֣יךָ אָרֽוּר׃ וְאֹרְרֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: kā·ra‘ šā·ḵaḇ ka·’ă·rî ū·ḵə·lā·ḇî mî yə·qî·men·nū ḇā·rūḵ mə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·ḵā ’ā·rūr wə·’ō·rə·re·ḵā
verses.literal: He crouches he lies down like a lion like a lioness who dares to rouse him Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you

verses.original: בָּלָק֙ אַ֤ף וַיִּֽחַר־ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם כַּפָּ֑יו וַיִּסְפֹּ֖ק אֶת־ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בָּלָ֜ק אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם קְרָאתִ֔יךָ לָקֹ֤ב אֹֽיְבַי֙ וְהִנֵּה֙ בֵּרַ֣כְתָּ בָרֵ֔ךְ זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bā·lāq ’ap̄ way·yi·ḥar- ’el- bil·‘ām kap·pāw way·yis·pōq ’eṯ- way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā lā·qōḇ ’ō·yə·ḇay wə·hin·nêh bê·raḵ·tā ḇā·rêḵ zeh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm
verses.literal: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam and he struck his hands together - and said . . . to Balaam I summoned you to curse my enemies but behold you have persisted in blessing [them] . . . these three times

verses.original: בְּרַח־ וְעַתָּ֖ה אֶל־ לְךָ֣ מְקוֹמֶ֑ךָ אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ כַּבֵּ֣ד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ֔ וְהִנֵּ֛ה יְהוָ֖ה מְנָעֲךָ֥ מִכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·raḥ- wə·‘at·tāh ’el- lə·ḵā mə·qō·w·me·ḵā ’ā·mar·tî kab·bêḏ ’ă·ḵab·beḏ·ḵā wə·hin·nêh Yah·weh mə·nā·‘ă·ḵā mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Therefore , flee at once to your home I said I would reward you richly . . . but instead the LORD has denied your reward

verses.original: בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל־ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר בָּלָ֑ק הֲלֹ֗א גַּ֧ם אֶל־ דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי לֵאמֹֽר׃ מַלְאָכֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥חְתָּ אֵלַ֖י
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām ’el- way·yō·mer bā·lāq hă·lō gam ’el- dib·bar·tî lê·mōr mal·’ā·ḵe·ḵā ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ·tā ’ê·lay
verses.literal: Balaam . . . answered Balak Did I not already . . . tell . . . the messengers - you sent me . . .

verses.original: אִם־ בָלָ֜ק יִתֶּן־ לִ֨י בֵיתוֹ֮ מְלֹ֣א כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָב֒ אוּכַ֗ל לֹ֣א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִלִּבִּ֑י טוֹבָ֛ה א֥וֹ רָעָ֖ה לַעֲבֹר֙ פִּ֣י אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḇā·lāq yit·ten- lî ḇê·ṯōw mə·lō ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ ’ū·ḵal lō la·‘ă·śō·wṯ mil·lib·bî ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ōw rā·‘āh la·‘ă·ḇōr pî ’eṯ- Yah·weh yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: that even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold I could not do anything of my own accord good or bad to go beyond the command - of the LORD I must speak whatever the LORD - says

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנְנִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לְעַמִּ֑י לְכָה֙ אִיעָ֣צְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַזֶּ֛ה הָעָ֥ם יַעֲשֶׂ֜ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ הַיָּמִֽים׃ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nî hō·w·lêḵ lə·‘am·mî lə·ḵāh ’î·‘ā·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer haz·zeh hā·‘ām ya·‘ă·śeh lə·‘am·mə·ḵā hay·yā·mîm bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ
verses.literal: Now . . . I am going back to my people but come let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נְאֻ֤ם בִּלְעָם֙ בְּנ֣וֹ בְעֹ֔ר וּנְאֻ֥ם הַגֶּ֖בֶר הָעָֽיִן׃ שְׁתֻ֥ם
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar nə·’um bil·‘ām bə·nōw ḇə·‘ōr ū·nə·’um hag·ge·ḇer hā·‘ā·yin šə·ṯum
verses.literal: Then [Balaam] lifted up an oracle saying [This is] the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open

verses.original: נְאֻ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ אִמְרֵי־ אֵ֔ל וְיֹדֵ֖עַ דַּ֣עַת עֶלְי֑וֹן יֶֽחֱזֶ֔ה מַחֲזֵ֤ה שַׁדַּי֙ נֹפֵ֖ל עֵינָֽיִם׃ וּגְל֥וּי
verses.transliteration: nə·’um šō·mê·a‘ ’im·rê- ’êl wə·yō·ḏê·a‘ da·‘aṯ ‘el·yō·wn ye·ḥĕ·zeh ma·ḥă·zêh šad·day nō·p̄êl ‘ê·nā·yim ū·ḡə·lui
verses.literal: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God who has knowledge . . . from the Most High who sees a vision from the Almighty who bows down with eyes wide open

verses.original: אֶרְאֶ֙נּוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א עַתָּ֔ה אֲשׁוּרֶ֖נּוּ וְלֹ֣א קָר֑וֹב כּוֹכָ֜ב דָּרַ֨ךְ מִֽיַּעֲקֹ֗ב שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ וְקָ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמָחַץ֙ פַּאֲתֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְקַרְקַ֖ר כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ שֵׁ֔ת׃
verses.transliteration: ’er·’en·nū wə·lō ‘at·tāh ’ă·šū·ren·nū wə·lō qā·rō·wḇ kō·w·ḵāḇ dā·raḵ mî·ya·‘ă·qōḇ šê·ḇeṭ wə·qām mî·yiś·rā·’êl ū·mā·ḥaṣ pa·’ă·ṯê mō·w·’āḇ wə·qar·qar kāl- bə·nê- šēṯ
verses.literal: I see him but not now I behold him but not near A star will come forth from Jacob and a scepter will arise from Israel He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth

verses.original: אֱד֜וֹם וְהָיָ֨ה יְרֵשָׁ֗ה יְרֵשָׁ֛ה וְהָיָ֧ה שֵׂעִ֖יר אֹיְבָ֑יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹ֥שֶׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·hā·yāh yə·rê·šāh yə·rê·šāh wə·hā·yāh śê·‘îr ’ō·yə·ḇāw wə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·śeh ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Edom will become a possession [as] will Seir his enemy but Israel will perform with valor

verses.original: וְיֵ֖רְדְּ מִֽיַּעֲקֹ֑ב וְהֶֽאֱבִ֥יד שָׂרִ֖יד מֵעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·rəd mî·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·he·’ĕ·ḇîḏ śā·rîḏ mê·‘îr
verses.literal: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר עֲמָלֵ֔ק רֵאשִׁ֤ית גּוֹיִם֙ וְאַחֲרִית֖וֹ עֲדֵ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar ‘ă·mā·lêq rê·šîṯ gō·w·yim wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw ‘ă·ḏê ’ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Then Balaam saw - Amalek and lifted up an oracle saying Amalek was first among the nations but his end . . . [is] destruction

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ הַקֵּינִ֔י וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מֽוֹשָׁבֶ֔ךָ אֵיתָן֙ קִנֶּֽךָ׃ וְשִׂ֥ים בַּסֶּ֖לַע
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’eṯ- haq·qê·nî way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar mō·wō·šā·ḇe·ḵā ’ê·ṯān qin·ne·ḵā wə·śîm bas·se·la‘
verses.literal: Next he saw - the Kenites and lifted up an oracle saying Your dwelling place is secure and your nest is set in a cliff

verses.original: כִּ֥י אִם־ קָ֑יִן יִהְיֶ֖ה לְבָ֣עֵֽר עַד־ מָ֖ה אַשּׁ֥וּר תִּשְׁבֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- qā·yin yih·yeh lə·ḇā·‘êr ‘aḏ- māh ’aš·šūr tiš·be·kā
verses.literal: Yet . . . Kain will be destroyed when . . . Asshur takes you captive

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר א֕וֹי מִ֥י יִחְיֶ֖ה אֵֽל׃ מִשֻּׂמ֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar ’ō·w mî yiḥ·yeh ’êl miś·śu·mōw
verses.literal: Once more [Balaam] lifted up an oracle saying Ah who can live unless God has ordained it

verses.original: וְצִים֙ מִיַּ֣ד כִּתִּ֔ים וְעִנּ֥וּ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְעִנּוּ־ עֵ֑בֶר ה֖וּא וְגַם־ אֹבֵֽד׃ עֲדֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣîm mî·yaḏ kit·tîm wə·‘in·nū ’aš·šūr wə·‘in·nū- ‘ê·ḇer hū wə·ḡam- ’ō·ḇêḏ ‘ă·ḏê
verses.literal: Ships [will come] from the coasts of Cyprus they will subdue Asshur . . . and Eber but they too will perish forever

verses.original: בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיָּ֣קָם וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיָּ֣שָׁב לִמְקֹמ֑וֹ בָּלָ֖ק וְגַם־ הָלַ֥ךְ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ām way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ way·yā·šāḇ lim·qō·mōw bā·lāq wə·ḡam- hā·laḵ lə·ḏar·kōw
verses.literal: Then Balaam arose vvv and returned to his homeland and Balak also went on his way
